objective: Find a robust paper-trading candidate for a $15 wallet without optimizing to a profit target.

current_best.status: historically admitted; forward paper evidence pending
current_best.evidence_summary: Historical evidence remains the strongest admitted result; no new candidate admitted in this iteration.
current_best.caveat: Historical admission is not forward/live proof or a profit guarantee.

constraints.funding: Include exact settled funding when applicable.
constraints.deploy_branch: Never write runtime evidence to main; use brain-state.

new_iteration.strategy_family: BTC-to-altcoin lead/lag prediction with strict non-overlapping out-of-sample signals
new_iteration.hypothesis: Lagged BTC returns may contain incremental predictive information for subsequent altcoin returns; strict non-overlap is required to avoid leakage.
new_iteration.preregistered_rules: Completed daily BTC candles only; fixed simple lag map trained only on information available before each decision; at most one long alt or cash; next-open fills; pessimistic intrabar ordering; adverse gap handling; $15 equity; $5 typical notional; $10 cap; one position; DCA=0; 7 bps/side base and 10 bps/side stress costs; exact funding when applicable; current minimum filters; development segment; chronological validation folds; multiple-testing correction; signal-economics screen; sealed final only after all gates pass.
new_iteration.data_window: Not executed. Repository search did not expose a reproducible historical OHLCV dataset/report set on main, and the research environment could not retrieve public Binance market-data files directly. No credentials or substitute dataset were used.
new_iteration.reason: Required public historical data could not be reproduced in this run, so development/validation folds and the sealed final were not opened. This is a data-integrity block, not evidence of unprofitability.

rejected_families: long/cash residual momentum after removing BTC or equal-weight market beta (blocked before valid backtest)
volume/flow-confirmed long-cash trend overlay (blocked before valid backtest)
BTC-to-altcoin lead/lag prediction with strict non-overlapping out-of-sample signals (blocked before valid backtest)
and all previously recorded rejected families in earlier ledger versions
research_rules: Test one genuinely distinct pre-registered family per iteration.
Use completed candles and next-open fills; never use future information.
Use development selection, chronological folds, cost stress and one sealed final evaluation.
Correct for multiple testing; never tune on the sealed final.
Reject a signal screen before execution code when raw cost-adjusted expectancy is negative or evidence gates fail.
Do not optimize to a requested monthly profit target or infer monthly profit from a small sample.
A pass permits paper validation only; live requires separate explicit approval.
next_queue: Keep admitted 30-day long/cash TSMOM forward paper settings frozen and collect real forward evidence.
Investigate trend plus funding-crowding filter using only settled funding known at decision time when exact public funding history and current minimum filters can be reproduced.
Investigate spot-versus-perpetual long/cash momentum under actual minimums and fees only when matched public spot/perpetual history is reproducible.
Construct a portfolio ensemble only after a second independently admitted low-correlation edge exists.
